text: Download Prarthana: Daily Hindu Prayers. 50 sacred texts in Hindi, English and Gujarati, many with the meaning of every verse, a festival calendar, devotional audio and a 108-bead jaap mala for iPhone and Apple Watch. No ads and no subscriptions. ॥ जय श्री राम ॥
Hanuman Chalisa in your pocket. Read it in Hindi, English or Gujarati, and make the letters as big as you like.
Many texts in Prarthana come with their meaning, verse by verse, so you understand what you read.
Count your jaap on a 108-bead mala with a gentle tap on every count. Carry on counting on your Apple Watch.
Never miss a festival. Prarthana lists festival dates for 2026 and 2027, with Ekadashi, Purnima, Amavasya and the monthly vrat days.
Chant recordings keep playing in the background. Pause or skip from the lock screen while you work.
A short thought for each morning, in Hindi, English or Gujarati, on your Home Screen and your Watch face too.
Aarti, Gayatri Mantra, Shiv Chalisa, Durga Saptashati and many more, all in one calm place. No ads and no subscriptions.
For Hanuman, Shiva, Durga, Krishna, Ganesh and Lakshmi. Prarthana has prayers for each, plus a Daily Prayers section.
Each day of the week suggests a deity in Prarthana, so you always know where to begin.
Turn on a reminder and Prarthana tells you about the next festival in good time.
The Next Festival widget shows the days to the next festival on your Home Screen or Lock Screen.
The Jaap Today widget shows your mala and your streak, with a bead button.
Prarthana works without internet once the app has loaded. Pray anywhere.
Read the Hanuman Chalisa with the meaning of every verse. Start your day with it.
Prarthana has no ads and no subscriptions. Just a calm space for daily prayer. ॥ जय श्री राम ॥
Choose your language: Hindi, English or Gujarati. Prarthana reads the same prayers in all three.
Ekadashi, Purnima and Amavasya reminders are in the Prarthana festival calendar.
Carry your mala on your wrist. The Prarthana Watch app counts your jaap beads.
Listen to a chant while you cook, travel or rest. Prarthana plays in the background.
Shiv Chalisa and Durga Saptashati sit next to the Hanuman Chalisa in Prarthana. One app, many prayers.
A small daily habit: open Prarthana, read one prayer, count one round of your mala.
Make the letters as big as you like. Prarthana is easy to read for every age in the family.
Share Prarthana with someone at home who prays every day.
Monthly vrat days are listed in the Prarthana festival calendar, so you can plan ahead.
Gayatri Mantra, aarti and daily prayers. Open Prarthana and begin where you like.
Your jaap streak shows on the Jaap Today widget. A gentle nudge to come back each day.
Prarthana for iPhone and Apple Watch: texts, festivals and a mala, close at hand.
Verse by verse meaning helps the prayer mean more. Many Prarthana texts include it.
Thank you for praying with Prarthana. ॥ जय श्री राम ॥
